tool_description: Get Spotify catalog information for a single album.

input_parameters.id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the album.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

output_parameters.id: The Spotify ID for the album.
output_parameters.name: The name of the album.
output_parameters.images: The cover art for the album.

tool_description: Get Spotify catalog information about an album's tracks.

input_parameters.id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the album.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.
input_parameters.offset: Query parameter, optional. The index of the first item to return.

output_parameters.items: An array of simplified track objects.
output_parameters.limit: The maximum number of items in the response.
output_parameters.offset: The offset of the items returned.
output_parameters.total: The total number of items available to return.

tool_description: Get Spotify catalog information for a single artist identified by their unique Spotify ID.

input_parameters.id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the artist.

output_parameters.id: The Spotify ID for the artist.
output_parameters.name: The name of the artist.
output_parameters.genres: A list of the genres the artist is associated with.
output_parameters.followers: Information about the followers of the artist.
output_parameters.images: Images of the artist in various sizes.

tool_description: Get Spotify catalog information about an artist's albums.

input_parameters.id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the artist.
input_parameters.include_groups: Query parameter, optional. A comma-separated list of keywords to filter the response.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.
input_parameters.offset: Query parameter, optional. The index of the first item to return.

output_parameters.items: An array of simplified album objects.
output_parameters.limit: The maximum number of items in the response.
output_parameters.offset: The offset of the items returned.
output_parameters.total: The total number of items available to return.

tool_description: Get Spotify catalog information about artists similar to a given artist.

input_parameters.id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the artist.

output_parameters.artists: A set of artist objects similar to the requested artist.

tool_description: Get Spotify catalog information about an artist's top tracks by country.

input_parameters.id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the artist.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

output_parameters.tracks: A set of track objects representing the artist's top tracks.

tool_description: Get a list of new album releases featured in Spotify.

input_parameters.country: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.
input_parameters.offset: Query parameter, optional. The index of the first item to return.

output_parameters.albums: A paged set of simplified album objects.

tool_description: Get detailed profile information about the current user.

output_parameters.id: The Spotify user ID for the user.
output_parameters.display_name: The name displayed on the user's profile.
output_parameters.followers: Information about the followers of the user.

tool_description: Remove one or more albums from the current user's 'Your Music' library.

input_parameters.ids: Query or Request Body parameter, required. A comma-separated list or JSON array of the Spotify IDs for the albums.

tool_description: Get a list of the albums saved in the current Spotify user's 'Your Music' library.

input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.
input_parameters.offset: Query parameter, optional. The index of the first item to return.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

output_parameters.items: An array of saved album objects.
output_parameters.limit: The maximum number of items in the response.
output_parameters.offset: The offset of the items returned.
output_parameters.total: The total number of items available to return.

tool_description: Save one or more albums to the current user's 'Your Music' library.

input_parameters.ids: Query or Request Body parameter, required. A comma-separated list or JSON array of the Spotify IDs for the albums.

tool_description: Remove the current user as a follower of one or more artists or other Spotify users.

input_parameters.type: Query parameter, required. The ID type: either artist or user.
input_parameters.ids: Query or Request Body parameter, required. A comma-separated list or JSON array of the Spotify IDs.

tool_description: Get the current user's followed artists.

input_parameters.type: Query parameter, required. The ID type: currently only artist is supported.
input_parameters.after: Query parameter, optional. The last artist ID retrieved from the previous request.
input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.

output_parameters.artists: A cursor-paged set of artist objects.

tool_description: Add the current user as a follower of one or more artists or other Spotify users.

input_parameters.type: Query parameter, required. The ID type: either artist or user.
input_parameters.ids: Query or Request Body parameter, required. A comma-separated list or JSON array of the Spotify IDs.

tool_description: Get information about the user's current playback state, including track or episode, progress, and active device.

input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
input_parameters.additional_types: Query parameter, optional. A comma-separated list of item types to support.

output_parameters.device: The device that is currently active.
output_parameters.shuffle_state: If shuffle is on or off.
output_parameters.item: The currently playing track or episode.
output_parameters.progress_ms: Progress into the currently playing track or episode.

tool_description: Get the track currently being played on the user's Spotify account.

input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
input_parameters.additional_types: Query parameter, optional. A comma-separated list of item types to support.

output_parameters.item: The currently playing track or episode.
output_parameters.progress_ms: Progress into the currently playing track or episode.

tool_description: Get information about a user's available devices.

output_parameters.devices: An array of device objects representing the user's available devices.

tool_description: Skips to next track in the user's queue.
Pause playback on the user's account.
Start a new context or resume current playback on the user's active device.

input_parameters.context_uri: Request Body parameter, optional. Spotify URI of the context to play.
input_parameters.uris: Request Body parameter, optional. A JSON array of the Spotify track URIs to play.
input_parameters.offset: Request Body parameter, optional. Indicates from where in the context playback should start.
input_parameters.position_ms: Request Body parameter, optional. Indicates the position in milliseconds to start from.

tool_description: Skips to previous track in the user's queue.
Get the list of objects that make up the user's queue.

output_parameters.currently_playing: The currently playing track or episode.
output_parameters.queue: An array of tracks or episodes in the queue.

tool_description: Add an item to the end of the user's current playback queue.

input_parameters.uri: Query parameter, required. The uri of the item to add to the queue.
input_parameters.device_id: Query parameter, optional. The id of the device this command is targeting.

tool_description: Get tracks from the current user's recently played tracks.

input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.
input_parameters.after: Query parameter, optional. A Unix timestamp in milliseconds to return items after.
input_parameters.before: Query parameter, optional. A Unix timestamp in milliseconds to return items before.

output_parameters.items: An array of play history objects.
output_parameters.next: URL to the next page of items.
output_parameters.cursors: The cursors used to find the next set of items.

tool_description: Set the repeat mode for the user's playback.

input_parameters.state: Query parameter, required. The repeat mode: track, context, or off.

tool_description: Set the volume for the user's current playback device.

input_parameters.volume_percent: Query parameter, required. The volume to set, from 0 to 100.

tool_description: Get a list of the playlists owned or followed by the current Spotify user.

input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.
input_parameters.offset: Query parameter, optional. The index of the first playlist to return.

output_parameters.items: An array of simplified playlist objects.
output_parameters.limit: The maximum number of items in the response.
output_parameters.offset: The offset of the items returned.
output_parameters.total: The total number of items available to return.

tool_description: Get the current user's top artists or tracks based on calculated affinity.

input_parameters.type: Path parameter, required. The type of entity to return: artists or tracks.
input_parameters.time_range: Query parameter, optional. Over what time frame the affinities are computed.
input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.
input_parameters.offset: Query parameter, optional. The index of the first item to return.

output_parameters.items: An array of artist or track objects.
output_parameters.limit: The maximum number of items in the response.
output_parameters.offset: The offset of the items returned.
output_parameters.total: The total number of items available to return.

tool_description: Remove one or more tracks from the current user's 'Your Music' library.

input_parameters.ids: Query or Request Body parameter, required. A comma-separated list or JSON array of the Spotify IDs for the tracks.

tool_description: Get a list of the songs saved in the current Spotify user's 'Your Music' library.

input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.
input_parameters.offset: Query parameter, optional. The index of the first item to return.

output_parameters.items: An array of saved track objects.
output_parameters.limit: The maximum number of items in the response.
output_parameters.offset: The offset of the items returned.
output_parameters.total: The total number of items available to return.

tool_description: Save one or more tracks to the current user's 'Your Music' library.

input_parameters.ids: Query or Request Body parameter, required. A comma-separated list or JSON array of the Spotify IDs for the tracks.

tool_description: Get a playlist owned by a Spotify user.

input_parameters.playlist_id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the playlist.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
input_parameters.fields: Query parameter, optional. Filters for the query.
input_parameters.additional_types: Query parameter, optional. A comma-separated list of item types that the client supports.

output_parameters.id: The Spotify ID for the playlist.
output_parameters.name: The name of the playlist.
output_parameters.owner: The user who owns the playlist.
output_parameters.followers: Information about the followers of the playlist.

tool_description: Change a playlist's name and public/private state.

input_parameters.playlist_id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the playlist.
input_parameters.name: Request Body parameter, optional. The new name for the playlist.
input_parameters.public: Request Body parameter, optional. If true the playlist will be public.
input_parameters.collaborative: Request Body parameter, optional. If true, the playlist will become collaborative.
input_parameters.description: Request Body parameter, optional. Value for playlist description.

tool_description: Remove one or more items from a user's playlist.

input_parameters.playlist_id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the playlist.
input_parameters.tracks: Request Body parameter, required. An array of objects containing Spotify URIs of the tracks or episodes to remove.
input_parameters.snapshot_id: Request Body parameter, optional. The playlist's snapshot ID against which you want to make the changes.

output_parameters.snapshot_id: A snapshot ID for the playlist.

tool_description: Get full details of the items of a playlist owned by a Spotify user.

input_parameters.playlist_id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the playlist.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
input_parameters.fields: Query parameter, optional. Filters for the query.
input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of items to return.
input_parameters.offset: Query parameter, optional. The index of the first item to return.
input_parameters.additional_types: Query parameter, optional. A comma-separated list of item types that the client supports.

output_parameters.items: An array of playlist track objects.
output_parameters.limit: The maximum number of items in the response.
output_parameters.offset: The offset of the items returned.
output_parameters.total: The total number of items available to return.

tool_description: Add one or more items to a user's playlist.

input_parameters.playlist_id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID of the playlist.
input_parameters.uris: Query or Request Body parameter, required. A comma-separated list or JSON array of Spotify URIs to add.
input_parameters.position: Query or Request Body parameter, optional. The position to insert the items.

output_parameters.snapshot_id: A snapshot ID for the playlist.

tool_description: Recommendations are generated based on the available information for a given seed entity and matched against similar artists and tracks.

input_parameters.seed_artists: Query parameter, required. A comma separated list of Spotify IDs for seed artists.
input_parameters.seed_genres: Query parameter, required. A comma separated list of any genres in the set of available genre seeds.
input_parameters.seed_tracks: Query parameter, required. A comma separated list of Spotify IDs for a seed track.
input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The target size of the list of recommended tracks.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

output_parameters.seeds: An array of recommendation seed objects.
output_parameters.tracks: An array of track object (simplified) ordered according to the parameters supplied.

tool_description: Get Spotify catalog information about albums, artists, playlists, tracks, shows, episodes or audiobooks that match a keyword string.

input_parameters.q: Query parameter, required. Your search query.
input_parameters.type: Query parameter, required. A comma-separated list of item types to search across.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
input_parameters.limit: Query parameter, optional. The maximum number of results to return in each item type.
input_parameters.offset: Query parameter, optional. The index of the first result to return.
input_parameters.include_external: Query parameter, optional. If include_external=audio is specified it signals that the client can play externally hosted audio content.

output_parameters.albums: A paged set of albums matching the query.
output_parameters.artists: A paged set of artists matching the query.
output_parameters.audiobooks: A paged set of audiobooks matching the query.
output_parameters.episodes: A paged set of episodes matching the query.
output_parameters.playlists: A paged set of playlists matching the query.
output_parameters.shows: A paged set of shows matching the query.
output_parameters.tracks: A paged set of tracks matching the query.

tool_description: Get Spotify catalog information for a single track identified by its unique Spotify ID.

input_parameters.id: Path parameter, required. The Spotify ID for the track.
input_parameters.market: Query parameter, optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

output_parameters.id: The Spotify ID for the track.
output_parameters.name: The name of the track.
output_parameters.album: The album on which the track appears.
output_parameters.artists: The artists who performed the track.
output_parameters.preview_url: A link to a 30 second preview (MP3 format) of the track.

tool_description: Create a playlist for a Spotify user.

input_parameters.user_id: Path parameter, required. The user's Spotify user ID.
input_parameters.name: Request Body parameter, required. The name for the new playlist.
input_parameters.public: Request Body parameter, optional. Defaults to true. If true the playlist will be public.
input_parameters.collaborative: Request Body parameter, optional. Defaults to false. If true the playlist will be collaborative.
input_parameters.description: Request Body parameter, optional. Value for playlist description.

output_parameters.id: The Spotify ID for the playlist.
output_parameters.name: The name of the playlist.
output_parameters.owner: The user who owns the playlist.
